name: Mastered Doctrines
summary: Up to 3 times per battle, pick an unused Combat Doctrine until your next Command phase: shoot after Advancing, shoot/charge after falling back, or charge after Advancing. Repeats need Marneus Calgar. Army: Ultramarines only.

name: Vulkan’s Quest
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault and add 1 Strength against targets within 12". With Vulkan He'stan in your army, Infernus Squads may start an Action after Advancing or shoot after starting one. Salamanders only.

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. Each Combat Doctrine can only be selected once per battle. Devastator Doctrine: this unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Masters of Shadow
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Restrictions
summary: Army composition restriction: the army may include Raven Guard units, but may not include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Unparalleled Tactician
summary: Once per battle round, if Aethon Shaan is on the battlefield, you can use the Into Darkness Stratagem for 0 Command Points.

name: Restrictions
summary: Army composition restriction: the army may include White Scars units, but may not include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Storm-swift Onslaught
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Wrath of the First Khan
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if a Suboden Khan unit destroyed an enemy unit this phase and isn't engaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.
